base_cone.assumption: finite cutoff with declared nondegenerate E_X and H_X pairings

stabilizing_module.name: K_X=direct_sum over admitted shells H_sep,p
stabilizing_module.role: retain full theta-pair separation densities and all Laplace moments
stabilizing_module.pairing: chosen source-derived separation-history pairing G_K; no scalar moment quotient

stabilized_carriers.pairing: G_E tensor G_K on arithmetic and G_H tensor G_K on history

adjoint_check: With tensor product pairings, (B_X tensor I_K)^dagger=B_X^dagger tensor I_K; hence the off-diagonal conservative sign and contragredient relation are preserved without new coefficients.

schur_check.kernel: ker(S_E^sep)=ker(S_E) tensor K_X at finite cutoff
schur_check.warning: stabilization repeats the base spectral condition over separation histories; it does not identify theta-pair densities with base Euler states

pair_bridge_embedding.formula: e_(p,2) tensor rho_g lies in E_X tensor K_X after including the Adams-two shell line in E_X
pair_bridge_embedding.result: the arithmetic carrier mismatch is repaired for the augmented candidate
pair_bridge_embedding.faithful_carrier: retain Graph(Q_X^sep) rather than quotienting by a moment functional

remaining_crossing.missing: j_H:H_rad,pair -> H_X tensor K_X intertwining A_rad with D0_X tensor I_K and U_rad with -(B_X tensor I_K)Q_X^sep

completion_boundary: At finite X all tensor identities are algebraic and bounded. Infinite-cutoff projective/nuclear completion requires separate uniform seminorm and domain estimates.
disposition: The old conservative cone admits a canonical finite separation-history stabilization C_X tensor I. This extends its pairings and adjoint without choices and receives the augmented cyclic-square bridge. It isolates the sole remaining finite comparison as the history intertwiner j_H; tensor stabilization does not manufacture that analytic incidence identity.
